privacy_ondevice_title: Aapka learning data aapke device par hi rehta hai
privacy_ondevice_body: Aapki progress, reviews aur settings sirf isi device par, aapke browser ki apni storage (IndexedDB) mein store hote hain. FrenchPath mein koi account nahi, koi analytics nahi, koi ads nahi aur koi crash reporting nahi. App mein aap jo bhi karte ho, uska kuchh bhi hum tak nahi aata.
privacy_backups_body: Backup ya encrypted sync file tabhi banti hai jab aap khud use banana chuno. Aap use jahan save ya share karo, wahin jaati hai. FrenchPath use kahin nahi bhejta.
privacy_mic_body: Microphone sirf tab use hota hai jab aap record karne ke liye tap karke khud ko record kar rahe ho (speaking exercises mein aur lesson ki new-words list par). Aapki awaaz aapke device par hi process hoti hai. Use kabhi upload nahi kiya jaata aur kabhi save nahi kiya jaata: recording sirf memory mein rakhi jaati hai taaki aap use play back kar sako ya apna score dekh sako, aur phir hata di jaati hai.
privacy_downloads_body: Sirf do features FrenchPath ke apne server se contact karte hain, aur woh bhi tabhi jab aap unhe use karo: speaking pack download karna (speech model jo aapke device par chalta hai) aur update check, jise aap Settings mein on kar sakte ho. Kisi bhi web request ki tarah, inse aapke device ka IP address us server ko dikhta hai jo app ko host karta hai. App ke apne pages aur files load karne ke alawa, FrenchPath koi aur network request nahi karta.
privacy_tts_body: Text-to-speech aapke device ki voices use karta hai, aur FrenchPath un voices ko pehle dikhata hai jo aapke device par chalti hain. Kuchh browsers mein voice browser ki company deti hai, aur woh network par chal sakti hai.
privacy_hosting_body: Jab aap web par FrenchPath load karte ho, to use host karne wali company standard server logs rakhti hai, jaise aapka IP address, time aur kaunsi file maangi gayi.
privacy_delete_body: Settings → Reset is device par FrenchPath ka store kiya hua sab kuchh hata deta hai: progress, settings, download kiya hua speaking pack aur app ki offline copies. Aap browser settings mein is site ka data bhi clear kar sakte ho.
privacy_contact_body: Settings → About mein “Problem batao ya idea suggest karo” use karo. Yeh hamara GitHub issues page kholta hai, jahan posts public hoti hain, isliye please koi personal information mat daalo. FrenchPath se bahar le jaane wale links (feedback, releases page) GitHub kholte hain, jiski apni privacy policy hai.
